case.title: From Xinjiang polysilicon to US solar imports: the Trina Solar chain
case.importer: TRINA SOLAR (U.S) INC (plus TRINA SOLAR US MANUFACTURING MODULE 1.LLC, Wilmer TX)
case.summary: Shipment records show Trina Solar's factories in Vietnam and Thailand sending solar modules (HS 8541/854143) to Trina Solar's US companies between 2021 and 2024. Upstream, Tradeverifyd records a trade link from Trina Solar's Chinese parent back to the wafer maker Tianjin Zhonghuan (TCL Zhonghuan), and from Zhonghuan back to Xinjiang GCL New Energy Material Technology, a polysilicon producer in Xinjiang that is on the UFLPA Entity List. The import legs are backed by shipment records; the China-side wafer and polysilicon links are trade-relationship indicators without shipment-level detail, and no record links the Xinjiang silicon-metal producer Hoshine to this chain.

gaps: No cross-border shipment records of Xinjiang polysilicon or silicon metal (HS 2804.61/2804.69) were found going to any wafer, cell or module maker in this chain. The China-side links are domestic and appear only as Tradeverifyd trade-relationship edges, without dates, volumes or shipment IDs.
No record links Hoshine Silicon Industry (Shanshan) to Xinjiang GCL or any polysilicon producer in this chain. Hoshine's recorded exports are silicones and silicon metal to Russian and other buyers.
No record shows which wafers or cells Trina's Vietnam and Thailand module plants used for the specific US shipments, so the modules cannot be traced to Xinjiang GCL polysilicon at shipment level.
No registry ownership record links Trina Solar Energy Development (Vietnam) to Trina Solar Co., Ltd. Sayari's beneficial-owner trace returned no owners.

Ownership percentages were not returned for any shareholder (Trina Solar Co., Ltd.; Jiangsu Zhongneng to Xinjiang GCL; the Hong Kong holding companies). No single ultimate beneficial owner is identified.
Trina Solar (U.S) Inc's only Sayari shareholder is 'TRINA AG' (USA, sparse identifiers), which does not resolve to the Chinese parent. The US importer's ultimate owner is unconfirmed.
The specific Xinjiang-based entity behind Trina Solar Co., Ltd.'s Sayari flag 'owner_of_forced_labor_xinjiang_entity' was not retrieved.

No CBP Withhold Release Order was found directly on any entity in the chain. Hoshine carries Sayari 'owned_by_wro_entity' / 'wro_entity_adjacent' indicators, but the WRO entity itself was not retrieved.
No Maxeon shipments to a major US importer were found. Sayari shows only 4 small US buyers (SeriousPlayer.com, Sun Powered Yachts).

Xinjiang Daqo New Energy (UFLPA; Tradeverifyd parent Daqo New Energy Corp) and Xinjiang East Hope Nonferrous Metals (UFLPA) were checked. Neither has a recorded downstream link to this chain: Daqo's only Tradeverifyd outbound edge is HS 2804610000 to a Russian buyer, and East Hope has no trade edges.
No latitude/longitude coordinates were returned by either tool for any entity.
notes: Status rules: 'verified' covers Sayari shipment-derived trade components (HS, countries, date ranges) and Sayari registry shareholder links. Tradeverifyd trade edges that carry only an HS code, with no shipment rows, are 'suspected'. For the China-side chain (Xinjiang GCL to TCL Zhonghuan to Trina Solar Co.) the edge HS code is 8541, not the 2804.61 polysilicon code, which suggests a coarse or derived classification. The UFLPA valid_from date for Xinjiang GCL was returned as 2026-08-03, and the Section 1260H valid_from date for Trina as 2026-06-08; both are reported exactly as returned. Tradeverifyd lists Maxeon as a parent of TCL Zhonghuan; that direction is unconfirmed and may be inverted. Sayari splits Trina's Thailand plant across several partial records (aEwbrgl9..., O6ZKEgct..., nlrQdMhy..., and a record labelled 'TRINA SOLAR', type person). The Sayari record used for Xinjiang GCL is named 新疆戈恩斯能源科技有限公司 (Goens), which Tradeverifyd lists as an alias of Xinjiang GCL; the two match on address. The Trina Solar (U.S.) Tradeverifyd ID is a name-only match. The two Sept 2024 Vietnam-to-Wilmer TX shipments have small declared values (about USD 630-741), so they may be samples. Many Sayari risk flags prefixed 'psa_' rely on 'possibly the same as' matches and are indicators only. Taken together, the records show a plausible exposure pathway, not proof that any particular US-imported module contains Xinjiang polysilicon.
